Quick update from packet captures (attached acme_postdeploy_pcap_0518.pcap):
- Observed repeated TCP retransmits on 10.55.2.14 <-> 10.41.32.10 during the 08:00–08:07 window. Retransmit count peaked at ~42 packets over that interval.
- The offending path crosses the east aggregation and appears to hit a microburst queue on firewall-2 during short bursts.
- I applied a temporary QoS workaround on the probe traffic (policed to 5Mbps) from our side and the retransmits dropped to single-digit counts.

Next actions I recommend:
1) EdgeCloud/Acme: approve ACL delta and confirm MTU remediation plan (either route around or raise interface MTU).
2) Acme FW team: investigate microburst behavior on firewall-2 and consider buffer tuning or ingress shaping.
3) Redwood: keep the probe policing in place until we validate steady-state after ACL change (24h).

I've pasted the minimal remediation commands in the attached routing-acl-diff-0518.patch and smoke-runbook-snippets.md for your ops teams.

- Karthik
